d:
Presenting “Seet Lehar (Dekh Le)” by Filmy featuring Tanu Rawat — a romantic Haryanvi song that has captured millions of hearts with its soulful melody, heartfelt lyrics and unforgettable charm.
Written and performed by Filmy, Seet Lehar brings together love, emotion and modern Haryanvi music in a beautifully crafted musical experience. Featuring Tanu Rawat, the official music video adds warmth and visual storytelling to a song that continues to connect with listeners across seasons.
